rules.title: Shaxs olmoshlari (Personal Pronouns)
rules.summary: Olmosh ot o'rnida ishlatiladi. Inglizchada ikki shakl bor: ega (kim?) shakli va to'ldiruvchi shakli.

sections.body:
Gapda ish-harakatni kim bajarayotganini bildiradi:
• I (men), you (sen/siz), he (u - erkak), she (u - ayol), it (u - narsa/hayvon), we (biz), they (ular)
Masalan: She works. They live here.

Harakat kimga qaratilganini bildiradi (predlogdan keyin ham shu shakl):
• me, you, him, her, it, us, you, them
I see him. Give it to them.

O'zbekchada 'u' erkak ham, ayol ham, narsa ham. Inglizchada uchta alohida so'z bor: he / she / it.
O'zbekchada ega ko'pincha tushib qoladi (Boraman). Inglizchada ega HECH QACHON tushmaydi: I go.

examples.en: I like her.
He helps us.
They know me.
We call him every day.
examples.uz: Biz unga har kuni qo'ng'iroq qilamiz.

examples.en: It is on the table.
Give the book to them.
She lives with us.

mistakes.why: Ega fe'ldan oldin turadi va 3-shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.

mistakes.wrong: He is my friend. I know he.
mistakes.right: He is my friend. I know him.
mistakes.why: Fe'ldan keyin ega shakli (he) emas, to'ldiruvchi shakli (him) kerak.

rules.tip: Fe'ldan OLDIN: I, he, she, we, they. Fe'ldan KEYIN: me, him, her, us, them.

quiz.q: Tom is my brother. I like ___ .

rules.title: To be fe'li (am / is / are)
rules.summary: To be - 'bo'lmoq, ...man/...san' ma'nosini beradi. Inglizchada gapda doim fe'l bo'lishi kerak, shuning uchun am/is/are kerak.

sections.body:
• I am (I'm)
• he / she / it is (he's, she's, it's)
• we / you / they are (we're, you're, they're)
She is a doctor. We are students.

So'roqda fe'l gap boshiga chiqadi: Are you tired? Is she at home?
Inkorda not qo'shiladi: I am not, he isn't, we aren't.
Qisqa javob: Yes, I am. / No, he isn't.

O'zbekchada 'Men talabaman' - fe'l yo'q, qo'shimcha (-man) bor. Inglizchada 'I student' deb bo'lmaydi: I AM a student.
Yoshni ham to be bilan aytamiz: I am 20 (I have 20 emas).

examples.en: I am a teacher.
She is at home.
We are friends.
Are you hungry?
He isn't here.
They aren't students.
Is it cold today?

mistakes.why: Gapda to be fe'li tushib qolmaydi.

rules.tip: I - am, he/she/it - is, qolganlari - are.

rules.title: Have got - egalik
rules.summary: Have got biror narsaga egalikni bildiradi (bor, ega bo'lmoq). Kundalik gapda keng ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
• I / you / we / they have got (I've got)
• he / she / it HAS got (she's got)
I've got a car. She has got two sisters.

So'roq: Have you got a pen? Has he got a dog?
Inkor: I haven't got a bike. She hasn't got a car.
Qisqa javobda got takrorlanmaydi: Yes, I have. / No, she hasn't.

O'zbekchada 'mening mashinam bor' deymiz. Inglizchada 'I have got a car' - ega boshida, 'bor' ma'nosi fe'lda.
Eslatma: 3-shaxs birlikda have emas, HAS ishlatiladi.

examples.en: I have got a new phone.
She has got brown eyes.
We haven't got a garden.
Have you got a brother?
Has he got a car?
They've got three children.
It hasn't got a tail.

rules.tip: 3-shaxsda have -> has: She HAS got. Qisqa javobda got yo'q.

quiz.q: ___ you got a dog? - Yes, I ___ .
quiz.why: you bilan have, qisqa javobda ham have.

rules.title: Can - qila olmoq
rules.summary: Can qobiliyat va imkoniyatni bildiradi (qila olaman / qila olmayman). Bu modal (yordamchi) fe'l.

sections.body:
Barcha shaxslarda bir xil: I can, he can, they can (he cans emas!).
Keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi, to'siz: I can swim.
Inkor: cannot yoki can't. So'roq: Can you swim?

• Qobiliyat: She can play the piano.
• Ruxsat so'rash: Can I open the window?
• Iltimos: Can you help me?
Qisqa javob: Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
O'zbekchada 'suza olaman' - fe'lga '-a ol' qo'shiladi. Inglizchada fe'l o'zgarmaydi, oldiga can qo'yiladi: I can swim.

examples.en: I can speak English.
He can't drive.
Can you help me?
She can run fast.
We can't come today.
Can I sit here?
They can cook very well.

mistakes.why: Can dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda.

rules.tip: Can + asosiy fe'l. -s yo'q, to yo'q, do yo'q.

rules.title: Present Simple (hozirgi oddiy zamon)
rules.summary: Present Simple odatlar, doimiy holatlar va umumiy haqiqatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
I / you / we / they + fe'l: I work.
he / she / it + fe'l + -s: He works.
Imlo: watch -> watches, study -> studies, go -> goes.

Yordamchi fe'l do / does ishlatiladi:
• Do you work? Does she work?
• I don't work. He doesn't work.
does dan keyin fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI: Does she work? (works emas).

• Odat: I get up at 7.
• Doimiy holat: She lives in Tashkent.
• Haqiqat: Water boils at 100 degrees.
Belgi so'zlar: always, usually, often, never, every day.

examples.en: I get up at seven.
She works in a bank.
They don't live here.
Does he play football?
We go to school every day.
My father doesn't drink coffee.
The sun rises in the east.

rules.tip: -s faqat tasdiq gapda: works. Does/doesn't bor joyda fe'l asosiy shaklda.

rules.title: Present Continuous (hozirgi davomli zamon)
rules.summary: Present Continuous aynan hozir yoki hozirgi kunlarda davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi.

sections.body:
am / is / are + fe'l-ing:
I am reading. She is cooking. They are playing.
So'roq: Are you listening? Inkor: He isn't sleeping.

• Ko'pchilik: work -> working
• -e tushadi: make -> making
• Qisqa unli+undosh ikkilanadi: run -> running, sit -> sitting

• Hozir: Look! It is raining.
• Hozirgi davr: I'm studying English this month.
Belgi so'zlar: now, at the moment, today, look!, listen!

examples.en: I am reading a book now.
She is cooking dinner.
They aren't watching TV.
Is he sleeping?
Look! It is raining.
We are learning English this year.
examples.uz: Biz bu yil ingliz tilini o'rganyapmiz.

examples.en: What are you doing?

rules.tip: am/is/are + -ing: 'hozir' degan ma'no bormi? Shuni tekshir.

rules.title: Present Simple va Present Continuous farqi
rules.summary: Odat va doimiy narsalar uchun Present Simple, hozir davom etayotgan ish uchun Present Continuous ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
• Present Simple - odat, doimiy: I drink tea every morning.
• Present Continuous - hozir: I am drinking tea now.

Simple: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day.
Continuous: now, at the moment, today, these days, look!, listen!

Like, love, want, know, need, understand kabi fe'llar odatda Continuous'da ishlatilmaydi: I want tea (I am wanting emas).
O'zbekchada 'ishlayapman' va 'ishlayman' tez-tez aralashadi - belgi so'zga qarab tanlang.

examples.en: I usually walk to work.
Today I'm taking the bus.
She plays tennis on Sundays.
She's playing tennis now.
He doesn't smoke.
Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
I want some water.

mistakes.wrong: I am going to school every day.
mistakes.right: I go to school every day.

rules.tip: Odat = Simple. Hozir = Continuous.

rules.title: Takrorlanish ravishlari (Adverbs of Frequency)
rules.summary: Biror ish qanchalik tez-tez bo'lishini bildiradi: always, usually, often, sometimes, never.

sections.body:
• always (doim) - 100%
• usually (odatda)
• often (tez-tez)
• sometimes (ba'zan)
• rarely / seldom (kamdan-kam)
• never (hech qachon) - 0%

Odatda ASOSIY fe'ldan OLDIN: I often read. She never eats meat.
To be fe'lidan KEYIN: He is always late.
Sometimes gap boshida ham bo'ladi: Sometimes I walk.

• Never o'zi inkor ma'noli, shuning uchun not qo'shilmaydi: I never drink coffee (I don't never emas).
• So'roq: How often do you go there? - Twice a week.
• every day, once a week kabi iboralar gap oxirida turadi.

examples.en: I always brush my teeth.
She usually walks to school.
We often eat out.
He is never late.
They sometimes watch films.
How often do you swim?
I go to the gym twice a week.

mistakes.why: Never o'zi inkor, qo'sh inkor yo'q.

rules.tip: Ravish fe'ldan OLDIN, lekin to be'dan KEYIN.

quiz.why: Ravish asosiy fe'ldan oldin: always drinks.
To be dan keyin: is always.

rules.title: Past Simple - to'g'ri fe'llar (-ed)
rules.summary: Past Simple o'tmishda tugagan ishni bildiradi. To'g'ri fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi.

sections.body:
Fe'l + -ed hamma shaxslarda bir xil: I worked, she worked, they worked.
Imlo: work -> worked; like -> liked (-e bor bo'lsa faqat -d); study -> studied; stop -> stopped.

Yordamchi did / didn't ishlatiladi, fe'l esa asosiy shaklga qaytadi:
• Did you work? - Yes, I did.
• I didn't work.
Did dan keyin -ed QO'SHILMAYDI.

O'tmishda aniq vaqtda tugagan ish: yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2020.
O'zbekchada -di qo'shimchasi: ishladim. Inglizchada fe'lning o'zi o'zgaradi.

examples.en: I worked yesterday.
She liked the film.
We played football last Sunday.
He studied hard.
Did you call me?
They didn't visit us.
I stopped at the shop.

rules.tip: Did bor joyda fe'l asosiy shaklda; did yo'q joyda -ed.

rules.title: Past Simple - noto'g'ri fe'llar
rules.summary: Ko'p keng tarqalgan fe'llar -ed olmaydi, ularning o'tgan shakli alohida yodlanadi.

sections.body:
• go - went
• have - had
• see - saw
• buy - bought
• eat - ate
• take - took
• come - came
• make - made
• write - wrote
• be - was / were

I / he / she / it was; we / you / they were.
So'roq: Was she at home? Inkor: I wasn't, they weren't.

Noto'g'ri fe'llar bilan ham did ishlatiladi: Did you go? I didn't go.
Did bor joyda went emas, asosiy shakl go qoladi. Faqat to be istisno: Were you there?

examples.en: I went to the park yesterday.
She bought a new dress.
We saw a good film.
He didn't come to school.
Did you eat breakfast?
They were tired.
I wrote a letter last week.

rules.tip: Did / didn't bo'lsa - asosiy shakl: go, see, buy.

rules.title: Used to (ilgari ... edi)
rules.summary: Used to o'tmishda takrorlangan odat yoki doimiy holatni bildiradi, hozir esa yo'q.

sections.body:
Tasdiq: I used to + asosiy fe'l: I used to play football.
Inkor: I didn't use to play.
So'roq: Did you use to play?
Used to dan keyin fe'l o'zgarmaydi; so'roq/inkorda use (d siz).

• Eski odat: I used to walk to school (endi yurmayman).
• Eski holat: We used to live in a village.
Faqat hozir takrorlanmaydigan ishlar uchun ishlatiladi.

O'zbekchada 'ilgari ... edim / ...ardim' deymiz: Ilgari mevani ko'p yer edim.
Inglizchada: I used to eat a lot of fruit. Bir marta bo'lgan ish uchun ishlatilmaydi: I went to Paris last year (used to emas).

examples.en: I used to play football.
She used to live in London.
We didn't use to have a car.
Did you use to smoke?
He used to be shy.
They used to visit us every summer.
examples.uz: Ular ilgari har yozda bizga kelardi.

examples.en: There used to be a cinema here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda ilgari kinoteatr bor edi.

mistakes.why: Used to dan keyin asosiy fe'l.

mistakes.wrong: She used to go to Paris last year.
mistakes.right: She went to Paris last year.
mistakes.why: Bir martalik ish uchun Past Simple.

rules.tip: Used to = ilgari shunday edi, endi yo'q.

quiz.q: I ___ eat a lot of sweets. Now I don't.

rules.title: So va Neither - qo'shilish
rules.summary: Boshqa odamning gapiga 'men ham' deb qo'shilish uchun so (tasdiq) va neither (inkor) ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
So + yordamchi fe'l + ega:
I like pizza. - So do I.
She is tired. - So am I.
I can swim. - So can I.
Yordamchi fe'l birinchi gapdagi zamonga mos bo'lishi kerak.

Neither + yordamchi fe'l + ega (fe'l tasdiq shaklida):
I don't like fish. - Neither do I.
He isn't here. - Neither am I.
Neither - 'ham emas' degani, shuning uchun qo'shimcha not kerak emas.

Fikr boshqacha bo'lsa:
I like tea. - I don't.
I don't like tea. - I do.
O'zbekchada 'Men ham' deymiz. Inglizchada fe'l kerak: So do I.

examples.en: I love music. - So do I.
examples.uz: Men musiqani yaxshi ko'raman. - Men ham.

examples.en: She can dance. - So can I.
examples.uz: U raqsga tusha oladi. - Men ham.

examples.en: I'm hungry. - So am I.
I don't like tea. - Neither do I.
He isn't ready. - Neither am I.
I can't swim. - Neither can I.
I like cats. - I don't.
examples.uz: Men mushukni yaxshi ko'raman. - Men yo'q.

mistakes.wrong: I like pizza. - So I do.
I don't like it. - Neither don't I.

mistakes.why: Yordamchi fe'l birinchi gapga mos: am.

rules.tip: So/Neither + yordamchi fe'l + EGA.

quiz.q: I live in Tashkent. - So ___ I.
I haven't got a car. - Neither ___ I.
She doesn't like coffee. - ___ do I.

rules.title: Sifatlar tartibi (Order of Adjectives)
rules.summary: Bir otdan oldin bir nechta sifat kelsa, ular ma'lum tartibda turadi. Tartibni buzsangiz, gap g'alati eshitiladi.

sections.body:
Fikr -> o'lcham -> yosh -> shakl -> rang -> kelib chiqish -> material -> ot.
Masalan: a beautiful (fikr) big (o'lcham) old (yosh) round (shakl) brown (rang) Italian (kelib chiqish) wooden (material) table.
Amalda 2-3 tadan ortiq sifat kam ishlatiladi.

Fikr sifatlari (nice, lovely, horrible, delicious) - har kimning fikri, doim BIRINCHI turadi.
Fakt sifatlari (big, old, red, Italian) - ob'ektiv, keyin keladi: a lovely big house; a nice red car.

O'zbekchada tartib erkinroq: 'qizil katta mashina' ham, 'katta qizil mashina' ham ayta olamiz. Inglizchada tartib qat'iy: a big red car (a red big car emas).
Sifat ko'plikda o'zgarmaydi: big houses (bigs houses emas), va sifat otdan OLDIN turadi.

examples.en: a nice big house
an old red car
a small round table
a lovely old Italian restaurant
a long black coat
two tall young men
a beautiful silk scarf

mistakes.why: Sifat otdan oldin keladi va ko'plikda o'zgarmaydi.

rules.tip: Fikr -> o'lcham -> yosh -> rang -> material -> ot. Fikr doim birinchi!

rules.title: Qiyosiy daraja (Comparative: -er / more ... than)
rules.summary: Ikki narsani solishtirish uchun sifatning qiyosiy darajasi ishlatiladi: bigger than, more expensive than.

sections.body:
• Qisqa (1 bo'g'in) sifat: + -er: tall -> taller, old -> older.
• -e bilan tugasa: + -r: large -> larger.
• Qisqa unli+undosh: ikkilanadi: big -> bigger, hot -> hotter.
• -y bilan tugasa: -ier: easy -> easier.
• Uzun (2+ bo'g'in): more + sifat: more expensive, more interesting.

Solishtirishda than (dan): She is taller than me.
Teng bo'lsa as ... as: He is as tall as his brother.
Teng emas: not as ... as: This book isn't as good as that one.

Quyidagilar o'zgacha: good -> better, bad -> worse, far -> further/farther.
O'zbekchada 'dan' qo'shimchasi (Mendan baland) - inglizchada than alohida so'z: taller than me.

examples.en: My brother is taller than me.
This bag is cheaper than that one.
Tashkent is bigger than Samarkand.
English is easier than Chinese.
This film is more interesting than the book.
She is as old as my sister.
The weather today is worse than yesterday.

mistakes.wrong: She is more tall than me.

rules.tip: Qisqa sifat: -er + than. Uzun sifat: more + sifat + than.

quiz.q: This exercise is ___ than that one.
This phone is ___ expensive ___ that one.

rules.title: Orttirma daraja (Superlative: the -est / the most)
rules.summary: Orttirma daraja uch yoki undan ortiq narsa ichida eng ko'p belgisi borini bildiradi: the biggest, the most beautiful.

sections.body:
• Qisqa sifat: the + -est: tall -> the tallest, old -> the oldest.
• -e bilan: the largest.
• Undosh ikkilanadi: big -> the biggest.
• -y: the happiest.
• Uzun sifat: the most + sifat: the most expensive.
Oldida doim the turadi.

Ko'pincha in (joy/guruh) yoki of (ko'plik) bilan: the tallest in the class, the best of all.
Faqat 'the' bor: He is the tallest boy (he is tallest boy emas).

good -> the best; bad -> the worst; far -> the furthest.
O'zbekchada 'eng' so'zi: eng baland. Inglizchada ikki qism: the + -est yoki the most.

examples.en: She is the tallest girl in the class.
This is the best film of the year.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
He is the funniest person I know.
examples.uz: U men taniydigan eng kulgili odam.

examples.en: It is the most expensive hotel in town.
This is the worst day of my life.
Who is the oldest in your family?

rules.tip: Orttirma daraja = THE + -est yoki THE MOST.

quiz.q: This is ___ road in the city.
She is ___ student in our group.
It was ___ day of my life. (yomon)

rules.title: Must va Can't - ishonch bildirish
rules.summary: Biror narsa haqida ishonch bildirish uchun must (shubhasiz shunday) va can't (shubhasiz bunday emas) ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
Aniq dalil bor bo'lsa: She must be at home - uning chiroqlari yoqilgan.
Must + be / fe'l asosiy shakli: He must be tired. They must know the answer.

Aniq bo'lmasligiga ishonsangiz: That can't be Tom - u Londonda.
Can't + be / fe'l: She can't be 20 - she is only a child.
Eslatma: 'mustn't' bu yerda ishlatilmaydi.

O'zbekchada 'Charchagan bo'lsa kerak' (must be tired) yoki 'u bo'lishi mumkin emas' (can't be). Inglizchada ikkalasi ham modal fe'l.
Shubha bo'lsa might / may ishlatamiz; ishonch bo'lsa must / can't.

examples.en: He must be at work.
She must be very rich.
You must be tired after the trip.
That can't be true.
They can't be at home. The lights are off.
examples.uz: Ular uyda bo'lishi mumkin emas. Chiroqlar o'chiq.

examples.en: He can't be 40. He looks 25.
examples.uz: U 40 da bo'lishi mumkin emas. 25 ga o'xshaydi.

examples.en: This must be the right address.

rules.tip: Ishonch bor: must be. Ishonch yo'q: can't be.

quiz.q: Look at his car! He ___ be rich.
She is only ten. She ___ be a doctor.
They ___ be at school. It's Sunday.

rules.title: Will - bashorat
rules.summary: Will kelajak haqida fikr yoki bashorat bildirish uchun ishlatiladi (bo'ladi, bo'lsa kerak).

sections.body:
Barcha shaxslarda bir xil: I will, he will, they will (qisqa: 'll).
Inkor: will not = won't. So'roq: Will it rain?
Keyin asosiy fe'l: It will be sunny.

Kelajak haqida fikr yoki bashorat:
• I think it will rain.
• She will be a great doctor.
Belgi so'zlar: I think, I hope, probably, tomorrow, next year, in the future.

O'zbekchada -adi/-ar qo'shimchasi: yomg'ir yog'adi. Inglizchada will + fe'l: It will rain.
I think / I hope dan keyin ham will ishlatamiz: I think he will come.

examples.en: It will rain tomorrow.
I think she will pass the exam.
We won't be late.
Will you be at home tonight?
People will travel to Mars one day.
examples.uz: Odamlar bir kun Marsga sayohat qiladi.

examples.en: He probably won't come.
I hope you will like it.

mistakes.right: I think it will rain tomorrow.

rules.tip: Will + asosiy fe'l: bashorat. Inkor: won't.

rules.title: Sifat va ravish (Adjectives and Adverbs)
rules.summary: Sifat otni tasvirlaydi (qanday?), ravish esa ish-harakat qanday bajarilganini bildiradi (qanday tarzda?).

sections.body:
• Sifat otdan oldin yoki to be dan keyin: a quick car; the car is quick.
• Ravish fe'ldan keyin: He drives quickly.
Sifat -> ot haqida; ravish -> fe'l haqida.

Ko'pincha sifat + -ly:
• slow -> slowly, quick -> quickly, careful -> carefully
• -y bilan tugasa: -ily: happy -> happily, easy -> easily
• -le bilan tugasa: -ly: gentle -> gently

Look, feel, sound, taste, smell, seem, be dan keyin sifat keladi (holatni bildiradi):
She looks happy (happily emas). The soup tastes good.
O'zbekchada 'qanday' so'rog'iga ikkalasi ham javob bo'ladi, shuning uchun adashadi.

examples.en: She is a careful driver.
She drives carefully.
The test was easy.
He passed the test easily.
The baby is sleeping quietly.
She looks tired.
They sang beautifully.

rules.tip: Ot haqida - sifat. Fe'l haqida (qanday?) - ravish (-ly).

rules.title: Ravishning alohida holatlari (good-well, fast, hard...)
rules.summary: Ba'zi ravishlar -ly bilan yasalmaydi yoki sifat bilan bir xil bo'ladi. Ularni alohida yodlash kerak.

sections.body:
Good - sifat; well - ravish:
She is a good singer. She sings well.
Well sog'liq haqida ham sifat bo'lishi mumkin: I'm well (sog'man).

fast, hard, late, early:
He is a fast runner. He runs fast.
Ish qattiq: He works hard. (hardly - deyarli yo'q, boshqa ma'no!)
Late - kech; lately - yaqinda.

• hard (qattiq) / hardly (deyarli ...mas): I hardly know him.
• late (kech) / lately (so'nggi paytlarda).
O'zbekchada bunday farq yo'q, shuning uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.

examples.en: She sings well.
He is a good cook.
He runs fast.
They work hard.
I get up early.
I arrived late.
I hardly know her.

rules.tip: Good - sifat, well - ravish. Fast, hard, late, early - o'zgarmaydi.

rules.title: Past Continuous (o'tgan davomli zamon)
rules.summary: Past Continuous o'tmishda ma'lum paytda davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi.

sections.body:
was / were + fe'l-ing:
I / he / she / it was working; we / you / they were working.
So'roq: Was she working? Inkor: They weren't working.

• O'tmishda ma'lum paytda davom etgan ish: At 8 o'clock I was having dinner.
• Ikki ish bir vaqtda: While I was cooking, he was watching TV.
• Fonni tasvirlash: It was raining and the wind was blowing.

O'zbekchada 'ishlayotgan edim' - davomiylik. Inglizchada ham was/were + -ing.
Holat fe'llari (know, like, want) Past Continuous'da ishlatilmaydi.

examples.en: I was reading at 9 o'clock.
She was cooking dinner.
They were playing football.
Was he sleeping?
We weren't watching TV.
What were you doing at 7?
It was raining all evening.

rules.tip: Was/were + -ing: o'tmishda jarayon.

rules.title: Past Simple va Past Continuous (when / while)
rules.summary: Uzoq davom etgan ish (Continuous) paytida qisqa voqea (Simple) sodir bo'lishi mumkin. Ularni when va while bog'laydi.

sections.body:
• Uzoq ish -> Past Continuous
• Qisqa voqea (to'xtatuvchi) -> Past Simple
I was walking when I saw an accident (yurayotgan edim - uzoq; ko'rdim - qisqa).

• While + Past Continuous: While I was walking, it started to rain.
• When + Past Simple: When it started to rain, I was walking.
Ikki uzoq ish birga: While she was cooking, he was reading.

Ketma-ket bo'lgan qisqa ishlar - hammasi Past Simple: I opened the door, saw a cat and screamed.
Uzoq jarayon sifatida - Continuous: I was opening the door when the phone rang.

examples.en: I was walking home when it started to rain.
While she was cooking, the phone rang.
He fell while he was running.
When I arrived, they were having lunch.
examples.uz: Men kelganimda ular tushlik qilayotgan edi.

examples.en: We were sleeping when the earthquake began.
I met Tom while I was shopping.
She was crying when I called.

mistakes.wrong: I was walking when I was seeing him.
mistakes.right: I was walking when I saw him.

mistakes.wrong: While I read, the phone rang.
mistakes.right: While I was reading, the phone rang.

mistakes.wrong: When I was arriving, she left.

rules.tip: Uzoq ish - was/were + -ing; qisqa voqea - Past Simple.

quiz.q: I ___ TV when the phone rang.
While we ___ , it started to rain.
She ___ the door when he came.

rules.title: Will - qaror, taklif, va'da
rules.summary: Shu zahoti qabul qilingan qaror, taklif va va'da uchun will ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
• Shu zahoti qaror: It's cold. I'll close the window.
• Taklif: I'll help you with the bags.
• Va'da: I will call you tomorrow.
• Bashorat: I think it will rain.

Will + asosiy fe'l; qisqa: 'll; inkor: won't.
So'roq/taklif: Shall I open the window? Will you help me?
Will barcha shaxslarda bir xil.

Will - shu zahoti qaror yoki taxmin. Going to - oldindan qilingan reja (keyingi qoidada).
O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham 'qilaman' bo'ladi, shuning uchun vaziyatga qarang: oldindan o'ylab qo'yganmisiz?

examples.en: I'll answer the phone.
It's heavy. I'll carry it for you.
examples.uz: U og'ir. Men sizga ko'tarib beraman.

examples.en: I will always love you.
I won't tell anyone.
Will you open the door, please?
I think she will win.
Shall I make some tea?

mistakes.wrong: I'm hungry. I'm going to make a sandwich now.
mistakes.right: I'm hungry. I'll make a sandwich.
mistakes.why: Shu zahoti qilingan qaror uchun will tabiiyroq.

rules.tip: Shu zahoti qaror, taklif, va'da = will.

quiz.q: The phone is ringing. I ___ answer it.
It's hot. ___ I open the window?

rules.title: Be going to - reja va dalilga asoslangan taxmin
rules.summary: Be going to oldindan o'ylab qo'yilgan reja yoki hozirgi dalilga ko'ra bo'ladigan voqeani bildiradi.

sections.body:
am / is / are + going to + asosiy fe'l:
I am going to study. She is going to travel.
So'roq: Are you going to come? Inkor: He isn't going to stay.

• Reja, niyat: I'm going to learn English this year.
• Dalilga ko'ra taxmin: Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
Gapirish paytida dalil ko'z oldingizda.

O'zbekchada 'qilmoqchiman' ma'nosi. Inglizchada: I'm going to do it.
Eslatma: going to dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda, to go ham mumkin: I'm going to go home.

examples.en: I'm going to buy a car.
She is going to have a baby.
We aren't going to stay long.
Are you going to watch the match?
Look at the sky! It's going to snow.
He is going to be late.
They are going to move to London.

mistakes.wrong: Look at the clouds! It will rain.
mistakes.right: Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.
mistakes.why: Ko'z oldingizda dalil bo'lsa going to ishlatiladi.

rules.tip: Going to: reja yoki ko'z oldingizdagi dalil.

quiz.q: I ___ buy a new phone next week. (reja)
Look at that car! It ___ crash.

rules.title: Present Continuous - kelajak (kelishilgan rejalar)
rules.summary: Aniq kelishilgan, vaqti belgilangan rejalar uchun Present Continuous ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
Kelishib bo'lingan reja (vaqt, joy aniq):
I'm meeting Anna at 6 tomorrow.
We are flying to Dubai on Friday.
Belgi: tomorrow, tonight, next week, on Monday.

am / is / are + fe'l-ing (hozirgidek).
Ko'pincha harakat fe'llari: go, come, meet, leave, fly, have dinner.
So'roq: What are you doing tonight?

Going to - niyat; Present Continuous - allaqachon kelishilgan.
I'm going to visit her (niyat). I'm visiting her on Sunday (borishga kelishilgan).
O'zbekchada: 'Dushanba kuni uchrashamiz' - kelishilgan.

examples.en: I'm meeting my friend at 5.
We're having a party on Saturday.
She's flying to Paris tomorrow.
What are you doing tonight?
They aren't coming to the party.
He's leaving at 8.
I'm seeing the dentist on Monday.

mistakes.why: Kelishilgan reja uchun Present Continuous kerak.

mistakes.wrong: We are go to the cinema tonight.
mistakes.right: We are going to the cinema tonight.

rules.tip: Kelishilgan, aniq vaqtli reja = am/is/are + -ing.

quiz.q: We ___ to Paris on Friday. (chipta olingan)

rules.title: 1-tur shart gap (First Conditional)
rules.summary: Haqiqiy kelajakda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan shartni va uning natijasini bildiradi.

sections.body:
If + Present Simple, will + asosiy fe'l:
If it rains, we will stay at home.
If shart qismi (If ...) Present Simple, natija qismi (will ...) kelasi zamon.
If qismi birinchi bo'lsa vergul qo'yiladi.

Qismlar o'rin almashishi mumkin (vergulsiz): We will stay at home if it rains.
Unless = if ... not: Unless you hurry, you will be late.
If dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi!

O'zbekchada: 'Yomg'ir yog'sa, uyda qolamiz'. Shart qismi -sa bilan, o'tgan emas hozirgi zamon.
Inglizchada: If it rains (rains, will rain emas), we'll stay.

examples.en: If it rains, we will stay at home.
If you study, you will pass the exam.
She will be angry if you are late.
If I see him, I'll tell him.
What will you do if you lose your job?
If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
Unless you hurry, you will be late.

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain, we'll stay.
mistakes.why: If dan keyin will emas, Present Simple.

mistakes.wrong: If I will see him, I tell him.
mistakes.right: If I see him, I'll tell him.

mistakes.wrong: If you will study, you pass.
mistakes.right: If you study, you will pass.

rules.tip: If + Present Simple, WILL + fe'l. If dan keyin will yo'q!

quiz.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay home.
If he ___ late, we'll start without him.
quiz.why: If dan keyin Present Simple: is.

rules.title: When va If - farqi
rules.summary: When - albatta bo'ladigan voqea, if - bo'lishi ham, bo'lmasligi ham mumkin bo'lgan voqea uchun ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
• When + Present Simple - bu aniq bo'ladi: When I get home, I'll call you (albatta kelaman).
• If + Present Simple - shubha bor: If I get home early, I'll call you (erta kelaman yoki kelmayman).

When, as soon as, after, before, until dan keyin ham Present Simple (will emas):
I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
Wait here until I come back.

O'zbekchada '-ganda' (when) va '-sa' (if). Ikkalasi ham hozirgi zamon shaklida qoladi.
Bu yerda ham will faqat natija qismida bo'ladi.

examples.en: When I get home, I'll call you.
If I get a day off, I'll visit you.
examples.uz: Dam olish kuni bo'lsa, sizga boraman.

examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
Wait until I come back.
Before you leave, lock the door.
After we eat, we'll go for a walk.
I'll tell her when she comes.

mistakes.wrong: When I will arrive, I'll call.
I'll wait until you will come.
As soon as I will know, I'll tell you.
mistakes.right: As soon as I know, I'll tell you.
mistakes.why: As soon as dan keyin Present Simple.

rules.tip: When / as soon as / until / before / after dan keyin ham will yo'q.

quiz.q: I'll call you when I ___ home.
I'm not sure I'll be free. ___ I am, I'll come.

rules.title: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar
rules.summary: Inglizchada otlar sanaladigan (countable) va sanalmaydigan (uncountable) turlarga bo'linadi. Bu qaysi so'z (a, many, much) ishlatilishini belgilaydi.

sections.body:
Birlik va ko'plikda bo'ladi, raqam bilan sanaladi: one apple, two apples.
Birlikda a/an ishlatiladi: a book, an egg.
Ko'plikda -s: books, eggs.

Sanab bo'lmaydi, a/an yo'q, ko'plik yo'q: water, milk, bread, money, information, advice.
San'ash kerak bo'lsa idish/o'lcham: a glass of water, a piece of bread, a bottle of milk.
Fe'l birlikda: The water is cold.

O'zbekchada 'ma'lumotlar', 'maslahatlar' deymiz. Inglizchada information, advice sanalmaydi: some information (informations emas).
Ba'zi otlar o'zbekchada sanaladi, inglizchada yo'q: news, money, furniture.

examples.en: I have an apple.
I have some apples.
I need some water.
She gave me some advice.
The money is on the table.
I'd like a glass of milk.
This is good news.

rules.tip: Sanasa bo'ladi: a/an, -s. Sanamasa: some, a piece of.

rules.title: Some va Any
rules.summary: Some va any - 'biroz, bir nechta' ma'nosini beradi, lekin ishlatilish o'rni har xil.

sections.body:
Tasdiq gapda: I have some friends. There is some milk.
Taklif va iltimosda ham some: Would you like some tea? Can I have some water? (javob 'ha' bo'lishini kutamiz).

Inkor: I don't have any friends. There isn't any milk.
So'roq: Do you have any friends? Is there any milk?
Ham sanaladigan (ko'plik), ham sanalmaydigan otlar bilan.

• Any - tasdiqda 'har qanday': You can take any book.
• Inkor/so'roqdagi any ni some ga almashtirib bo'lmaydi.
O'zbekchada 'bir nechta' va 'hech qanday' ni aralashtirmang - biri tasdiq, biri inkor.

examples.en: I have some friends in London.
There isn't any milk.
Do you have any questions?
Would you like some tea?
She doesn't have any brothers.
Can I have some water, please?
I bought some bread but no eggs.

rules.tip: Tasdiq - some; inkor va so'roq - any (taklif - some).

rules.title: Much va Many
rules.summary: Many sanaladigan ko'plik otlar bilan, much sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ishlatiladi. Ikkalasi 'ko'p' degani.

sections.body:
• many + ko'plikdagi ot: many books, many people
• much + sanalmaydigan ot: much water, much time
So'roq: How many apples? How much milk?

Much va many asosan inkor va so'roqda: I don't have much time. Do you have many friends?
Tasdiqda a lot of ishlatiladi: I have a lot of time. She has a lot of friends.
Too much / too many - 'juda ham ko'p' (ortiqcha).

O'zbekchada 'ko'p' hammaga to'g'ri keladi: ko'p kitob, ko'p suv. Inglizchada tanlash kerak: many books, much water.
So'rashda ham: How many kitob, How much suv.

examples.en: I don't have many friends.
There isn't much milk.
How many people are there?
How much money do you have?
She has a lot of books.
We have too much homework.
There are too many cars here.

mistakes.wrong: How much books do you have?
mistakes.right: How many books do you have?
I have a lot of friends.

rules.tip: Sanaladi - many; sanalmaydi - much; tasdiq - a lot of.

rules.title: A few va A little
rules.summary: A few - sanaladigan otlar bilan 'bir nechta'; a little - sanalmaydigan otlar bilan 'biroz'.

sections.body:
• a few + ko'plik: a few friends, a few apples
• a little + sanalmaydigan: a little water, a little time
Ikkalasi ham ijobiy ma'noda: ozgina bor, yetarli.

Few / little - 'deyarli yo'q, juda kam' (salbiy ma'no):
I have few friends (yetarli emas).
She has little money (deyarli yo'q).
A bilan ijobiy: I have a few friends (bir nechta bor).

• Quite a few = ancha ko'p.
• Only a few = atigi bir necha.
O'zbekchada 'bir nechta' va 'kam' ni bir xil deymiz, inglizchada a bor-yo'qligi ma'noni o'zgartiradi.

examples.en: I have a few friends here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda bir nechta do'stim bor.

examples.en: There is a little milk in the fridge.
She has few friends.
We have little time.
Can I ask you a few questions?
examples.uz: Sizga bir nechta savol bersam bo'ladimi?

examples.en: Add a little sugar.
Only a few people came.

mistakes.wrong: I have few friends, so I'm happy. (bir nechta)
mistakes.right: I have a few friends, so I'm happy.

rules.tip: A few - sanaladigan; a little - sanalmaydigan. A siz - kam, salbiy.

quiz.q: I'd like ___ sugar in my tea.
She has ___ friends in this city. (bir nechta)
He has ___ money, so he can't buy it.

rules.title: Should va Shouldn't - maslahat
rules.summary: Should maslahat berish uchun ishlatiladi: 'qilsangiz yaxshi bo'ladi'. Shouldn't - 'qilmasangiz yaxshi'.

sections.body:
Should + asosiy fe'l, barcha shaxslarda bir xil (should, shouldn't).
You should go to bed early. She shouldn't eat so much.
So'roq: Should I call him?

• Maslahat: You should see a doctor.
• Fikr: I think you should study more.
• So'rash: What should I do?
I think you should... / I don't think you should...

Should - maslahat (majburiy emas). Must - majburiyat.
O'zbekchada 'kerak' hammasiga ishlatiladi; inglizchada darajasi bor: should (yaxshi bo'ladi) < have to < must.

examples.en: You should drink more water.
He shouldn't eat so much sugar.
Should I call her?
I think you should rest.
You shouldn't stay up late.
What should I do?
They should visit the doctor.

rules.tip: Should + asosiy fe'l - maslahat. -s, to, do yo'q.

quiz.q: You have a headache. You ___ take a pill.
She ___ eat so much fast food.

rules.title: 0-tur shart gap (Zero Conditional)
rules.summary: Zero Conditional doim to'g'ri bo'ladigan haqiqatlar va umumiy qoidalar uchun ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
If / When + Present Simple, Present Simple:
If you heat ice, it melts.
When it rains, the grass gets wet.
Ikkala qismda ham Present Simple.

• Ilmiy fakt: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
• Umumiy qoida va odat: If I am tired, I go to bed early.
Bu yerda if va when deyarli bir xil ma'noda.

1-tur: kelajakdagi aniq voqea (if ... will). 0-tur: har doim to'g'ri (ikkala qism Present Simple).
O'zbekchada: 'Suvni qizdirsang, qaynaydi' - umumiy haqiqat.

examples.en: If you heat ice, it melts.
When it rains, the streets get wet.
If I drink coffee, I can't sleep.
If you press this button, the light turns on.
Water boils if you heat it to 100 degrees.
When I'm tired, I go to bed early.
If people don't eat, they get hungry.

mistakes.wrong: If you heat ice, it will melt. (umumiy haqiqat)
mistakes.right: If you heat ice, it melts.

mistakes.wrong: If it rains, the grass will get wet. (har doim)
mistakes.right: If it rains, the grass gets wet.

mistakes.wrong: When it rain, the grass gets wet.
mistakes.right: When it rains, the grass gets wet.

rules.tip: Zero: if + Simple, Simple (doim to'g'ri).

quiz.q: If you ___ water to 100 degrees, it boils.
When it rains, the road ___ wet.
If I ___ coffee at night, I can't sleep.

rules.title: Present Perfect - shakli
rules.summary: Present Perfect o'tmishda boshlangan, lekin hozirga aloqasi bor ishni bildiradi. Avval uning shaklini o'rganamiz.

sections.body:
have / has + fe'lning 3-shakli (past participle):
I have worked. She has finished.
To'g'ri fe'llarda 3-shakl = -ed: worked, played, studied.
Qisqa: I've, you've, he's, she's, we've, they've.

go - gone, see - seen, eat - eaten, write - written, take - taken, do - done, be - been, have - had, buy - bought, make - made.
Ularni yodlash kerak (Past Simple shakli bilan chalkashtirmang: went emas, gone).

So'roq: Have you finished? Has she called?
Inkor: I haven't seen it. He hasn't arrived.
Qisqa javob: Yes, I have. / No, she hasn't.
O'zbekchada '-gan' (ko'rgan, borgan) - Present Perfect ga yaqin.

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
She has lost her keys.
They have bought a new car.
We haven't seen that film.
Has he called you?
Have you eaten?
It has stopped raining.

rules.tip: Have/has + 3-shakl (V3).

rules.title: Present Perfect - hayot tajribasi (ever / never)
rules.summary: Hayotingiz davomida biror narsani qilgan-qilmaganingiz haqida gapirishda Present Perfect ishlatiladi. Aniq vaqt aytilmaydi.

sections.body:
Aniq vaqti ahamiyatsiz, tajriba muhim:
I have been to London (hayotimda bo'lganman).
Have you ever eaten sushi?
Aniq vaqt aytsangiz Past Simple kerak: I went to London in 2019.

• ever - hech qachon (so'roqda): Have you ever seen a bear?
• never - hech qachon (tasdiqda, o'zi inkor): I have never seen a bear.
Ever / never have/has dan KEYIN, V3 dan OLDIN turadi.

Yes, I have. / No, I haven't. / Yes, I have - twice. Ikkinchi marta haqida: It was great (Past Simple, tafsilot).
O'zbekchada 'ko'rganmisiz?' - Have you ever seen?

examples.en: I have been to Paris.
Have you ever eaten sushi?
She has never flown in a plane.
We have visited many countries.
He has never been late.
Have you ever met a famous person?
I've seen that film three times.
examples.uz: Men u filmni uch marta ko'rganman.

mistakes.wrong: I have ever been to Rome.
Did you ever see a ghost?
mistakes.right: Have you ever seen a ghost?

rules.tip: Hayot tajribasi: Have you ever...? I have never...

rules.title: For va Since - qancha vaqtdan beri
rules.summary: For (davomiylik) va since (boshlanish nuqtasi) Present Perfect bilan 'qancha vaqtdan beri' ma'nosini beradi.

sections.body:
For + vaqt oralig'i: for two years, for three days, for a long time.
I have lived here for ten years.

Since + boshlanish momenti: since 2015, since Monday, since I was a child, since last year.
She has worked here since January.

O'zbekchada 'o'n yildan beri yashayman' (hozirgi zamon!). Inglizchada: I have lived here for ten years - Present Perfect.
I live here for ten years - xato.
Savol: How long have you lived here?

examples.en: I have lived here for five years.
examples.uz: Men bu yerda besh yildan beri yashayman.

examples.en: She has worked here since 2018.
examples.uz: U bu yerda 2018 yildan beri ishlaydi.

examples.en: They have been married for ten years.
examples.uz: Ular o'n yildan beri turmush qurgan.

examples.en: I've known him since childhood.
How long have you studied English?
examples.uz: Ingliz tilini qancha vaqtdan beri o'rganasiz?

examples.en: We haven't seen her for a week.
examples.uz: Biz uni bir haftadan beri ko'rmadik.

examples.en: He has been ill since Monday.

mistakes.wrong: I live here for five years.
mistakes.right: I have lived here for five years.

mistakes.wrong: I have lived here since five years.
mistakes.right: I have lived here for five years.
He has been ill since Monday.

rules.tip: For + qancha davom etdi; since + qachondan boshlandi.

quiz.q: I have known her ___ ten years.

rules.title: Just, Already, Yet
rules.summary: Bu so'zlar Present Perfect bilan yaqinda tugagan yoki kutilgan ishni bildiradi.

sections.body:
• just - hozirgina: I have just finished.
• already - allaqachon: She has already left.
Ikkalasi ham have/has dan keyin, V3 dan oldin turadi.

• Inkor: I haven't finished yet (hali).
• So'roq: Have you finished yet? (allaqachon-mi?)
Yet gap OXIRIDA turadi.

O'zbekchada 'hozirgina', 'allaqachon', 'hali' deymiz. Inglizchada joyi qat'iy: just/already - o'rtada; yet - oxirida.
Amerika inglizchasida Past Simple ham mumkin, lekin kitobdagi shakl Present Perfect.

examples.en: I have just finished my homework.
She has already eaten.
Have you finished yet?
I haven't called him yet.
They have just arrived.
He has already seen that film.
Has she come yet?

rules.tip: Just/already - o'rtada; yet - oxirida (inkor va so'roq).

rules.title: Have been va Have gone
rules.summary: Have been - borgan va qaytib kelgan; have gone - ketgan va hali qaytmagan.

sections.body:
Borib kelgan (hozir bu yerda):
I have been to London (u yerda bo'lganman, endi qaytganman).
Have you ever been to Spain?
Tajribani bildiradi.

Ketgan va hali qaytmagan (hozir u yerda yoki yo'lda):
She has gone to Paris (u hozir Parijda).
He has gone out (uyda yo'q).

Been to / gone to ishlatiladi: I have been to Rome. (in emas!)
Farq muhim: O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham 'borgan' bo'ladi, lekin inglizchada qaytgan-qaytmaganligi farq qiladi.

examples.en: I have been to Paris.
She has gone to Paris.
Where have you been?
He has gone out.
They have been to Italy twice.
Tom isn't here. He has gone home.
examples.uz: Tom bu yerda yo'q. U uyga ketgan.

examples.en: Have you ever been to Japan?

mistakes.wrong: She has been to the shop. (hali u yerda)
mistakes.right: She has gone to the shop.

rules.tip: Been - qaytib kelgan; gone - hali u yerda.

quiz.q: Where's Anna? - She ___ to the shop.
I ___ to Japan twice. I love it!

rules.title: Past Simple va Present Perfect farqi
rules.summary: Aniq vaqt bor bo'lsa Past Simple, vaqt aytilmagan yoki hozirgacha davom etayotgan bo'lsa Present Perfect ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
Aniq o'tgan vaqt (yesterday, last year, in 2020, two days ago, when):
I saw him yesterday. She lived in London in 2015.
Ish butunlay tugagan.

Vaqt aytilmagan yoki hozirgacha tegishli (ever, never, just, already, yet, for, since, this week):
I have seen him. She has lived here since 2015.
Natija hozir ham muhim.

• When ...? so'rog'ida - Past Simple (When did you arrive?).
• Hozirgi davr (today, this week) - Present Perfect.
O'zbekchada o'tgan zamon shakllari ko'p (-di, -gan, -gan edi), inglizchada ikkita zamon tanlash kerak.

examples.en: I saw him yesterday.
I have seen him already.
She lived in Paris in 2015.
She has lived in Paris since 2015.
When did you arrive?
I have lost my keys.
We have had three exams this week.
examples.uz: Bu hafta bizda uchta imtihon bo'ldi.

rules.tip: Aniq vaqt = Past Simple. Hozirgacha/natija = Present Perfect.

rules.title: Present Perfect Continuous
rules.summary: Present Perfect Continuous o'tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan (yoki hozirgina tugagan) jarayonni, uning davomiyligini ta'kidlaydi.

sections.body:
have / has + been + fe'l-ing:
I have been working. She has been studying.
So'roq: Have you been waiting? Inkor: I haven't been sleeping.

• Davomiyligi muhim: I have been waiting for two hours.
• Hozirgina tugagan, natijasi ko'rinib turibdi: You look tired. - I have been running.
How long ...? bilan: How long have you been learning English?

• Continuous - jarayon: I have been painting the room (hali tugamagan bo'lishi mumkin).
• Simple - natija: I have painted the room (tugagan).
Holat fe'llari (know, like) Continuous'da ishlatilmaydi: I have known her for years.

examples.en: I have been waiting for an hour.
She has been learning English since January.
examples.uz: U yanvardan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapti.

examples.en: They have been playing football all day.
It has been raining all morning.
How long have you been working here?
examples.uz: Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri ishlaysiz?

examples.en: You are dirty. What have you been doing?
He hasn't been feeling well.

mistakes.wrong: I am waiting for two hours.
mistakes.right: I have been waiting for two hours.

mistakes.wrong: I have been know her for years.
mistakes.right: I have known her for years.

rules.tip: Have/has + BEEN + -ing: qancha davom etganini ta'kidlaydi.

quiz.q: I ___ for you for an hour!
How long ___ she been working here?

rules.title: Past Perfect - shakli
rules.summary: Past Perfect (o'tgan tugallangan zamon) o'tmishdagi biror payttdan OLDIN tugagan ishni bildiradi. Shakli: had + 3-shakl.

sections.body:
• Tasdiq: ega + had + 3-shakl (V3)
  I had cleaned the room.
• So'roq: Had + ega + 3-shakl?
  Had she cleaned the room?
• Inkor: ega + had not (hadn't) + 3-shakl
  She hadn't cleaned the room.
• Qisqa shakl: I'd, he'd, they'd (= had)

Had ham I, ham he, ham they bilan o'zgarmaydi. Has yoki have ishlatilmaydi!

Qolip:
ega + had + V3
I / you / he / she / it / we / they + had + finished

V3 - fe'lning uchinchi shakli.
• To'g'ri fe'llar: -ed qo'shiladi (clean - cleaned, work - worked)
• Noto'g'ri fe'llar: yodlanadi (go - gone, see - seen, buy - bought, do - done)

Had she cleaned the room? - Yes, she had. / No, she hadn't.
Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi, faqat had / hadn't aytiladi.

examples.en: I had cleaned my room before my mother came.
examples.uz: Onam kelishidan oldin xonamni yig'ishtirib bo'lgandim.

examples.en: She hadn't done the laundry.
Had they bought the tickets?
We'd already eaten when he called.
examples.uz: U qo'ng'iroq qilganda biz allaqachon ovqatlangan edik.

examples.en: He said he had lost his keys.

mistakes.wrong: She has done the ironing before I came.
mistakes.right: She had done the ironing before I came.
mistakes.why: 'Before I came' o'tmishdagi payt, shuning uchun has emas, had kerak.
Had dan keyin 3-shakl keladi: go - went - gone.

mistakes.wrong: Did she had cleaned the room?
mistakes.why: So'roqda did kerak emas: had ega oldiga chiqadi.

rules.tip: Had + V3: had har doim bir xil, o'zgaradigan faqat fe'lning 3-shakli.

quiz.q: They ___ the dishes before the guests arrived.

quiz.why: Past Perfect so'roqda Had + ega + V3.

rules.title: Past Perfect - qachon ishlatiladi
rules.summary: Ikki o'tgan ishdan OLDINGISI uchun Past Perfect, KEYINGISI uchun Past Simple ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
O'tmishda ikkita ish bo'lsa:
• oldin bo'lgani - Past Perfect (had + V3)
• keyin bo'lgani - Past Simple (V2)

When I arrived, the film had started.
(Avval film boshlandi, keyin men keldim.)

Past Perfect bilan ko'p keladigan so'zlar:
• already (allaqachon), just (hozirgina), never (hech qachon)
• before (...dan oldin), after (...dan keyin), when (qachonki), by the time (...ga kelib)

After she had left, I went to bed.

O'zbek tilida 'ketgan edi', '-gan edi' shakli Past Perfectga yaqin: 'U ketgan edi, men keldim' = She had left when I came.
Lekin ingliz tilida bu shakl faqat ikki ish solishtirilganda kerak. Bitta o'tgan ish bo'lsa Past Simple yetadi.

Ish ketma-ket bo'lib, tartib aniq bo'lsa Past Simple ham mumkin: I got up and had breakfast.
Tartibni alohida ta'kidlash kerak bo'lsa (oldin / keyin) Past Perfect ishlatiladi.

examples.en: Jim had just cast his line when the boat began to rock.
examples.uz: Jim hozirgina qarmog'ini tashlagan edi, shu payt qayiq chayqala boshladi.

examples.en: I had never seen the sea before that day.
examples.uz: O'sha kungacha dengizni hech ko'rmagan edim.

examples.en: After the film had ended, we went home.
examples.uz: Film tugagandan keyin biz uyga ketdik.

examples.en: Tracy served dinner after all the guests had arrived.
examples.uz: Tracy hamma mehmonlar kelgandan keyin kechki ovqat tortdi.

examples.en: By the time I got there, they had left.
examples.uz: Men yetib borgunimcha ular ketib bo'lgan edi.

mistakes.wrong: When I arrived at the station, the train already left.
mistakes.right: When I arrived at the station, the train had already left.
mistakes.why: Poyezd men kelishimdan OLDIN ketgan, shuning uchun had + V3.
Bitta o'tgan ish va 'yesterday' bo'lsa Past Simple yetadi.

mistakes.wrong: After he finished, he had gone home.
mistakes.right: After he had finished, he went home.
mistakes.why: Oldingi ish (finish) Past Perfect, keyingisi (go) Past Simple bo'ladi.

rules.tip: Oldin bo'lgan ish - had + V3. Keyin bo'lgan ish - V2. Vaqt chizig'ini chizib ko'ring.

quiz.why: Avtobus biz kelishimizdan oldin ketgan: had left.

quiz.q: She ___ finished her homework before she watched TV.
After I ___ breakfast, I went to work.
quiz.why: After + had + V3, keyin Past Simple: went. (have - had - had)

rules.title: Majhul nisbat (Passive) - shakli
rules.summary: Majhul nisbatda ish kim qilgani emas, nima qilingani muhim. Shakli: to be + 3-shakl. Zamon 'to be' orqali ko'rsatiladi.

sections.body:
Passive = to be (kerakli zamonda) + V3

• Present Simple: is / are + V3 - The dog is fed twice a day.
• Past Simple: was / were + V3 - The cake was made yesterday.
• Present Continuous: is / are being + V3 - The car is being repaired.
• Present Perfect: has / have been + V3 - The work has been done.
• Future: will be + V3 - It will be finished soon.

• Tasdiq: The window was broken.
• So'roq: Was the window broken?
• Inkor: The window wasn't broken.

Faqat to be fe'li o'zgaradi (zamon, son), V3 o'zgarmaydi.

O'zbek tilida majhul nisbat fe'lga -il, -in qo'shimchasi bilan yasaladi: yozildi, qurildi.
Ingliz tilida qo'shimcha yo'q: was written, was built (to be + V3).
To be ega bilan moslashadi: The book is sold. - The books are sold. - The book was sold. - The books were sold.

examples.en: The dog is fed twice a day.
The room was cleaned yesterday.
These cars are made in Germany.
The bridge was built in 1990.
Was the letter sent?

mistakes.why: Passive'da to be (was) tushib qolmasligi kerak.

mistakes.wrong: The door is open by Tom.
mistakes.right: The door is opened by Tom.

rules.tip: Passive = to be + V3. Zamonni 'to be' ko'taradi, V3 o'zgarmaydi.

quiz.why: Ko'plik va o'tgan zamon: were built.
Present Simple Passive so'roq: Is + ega + V3?

rules.title: Faoldan majhulga o'tkazish
rules.summary: Faol gapni majhulga aylantirish 3 qadamdan iborat: to'ldiruvchi ega bo'ladi, to be qo'shiladi, fe'l V3 bo'ladi.

sections.body:
Faol: Susan made a cake.
1) To'ldiruvchi (kimni? nimani?) ega bo'ladi: A cake
2) To be o'sha zamonda qo'yiladi: was
3) Fe'l V3 bo'ladi: made
Majhul: A cake was made by Susan.

Ega (Susan) kerak bo'lsa by bilan oxirida keladi.

Faol gapdagi zamon majhulda ham saqlanadi:
• Tom writes letters. - Letters are written by Tom.
• Tom wrote letters. - Letters were written by Tom.
• Tom is writing a letter. - A letter is being written by Tom.
• Tom has written a letter. - A letter has been written by Tom.

Olmosh shakli ham o'zgaradi: I - me, he - him, she - her, we - us, they - them.
They broke the window. - The window was broken by them.
Majhulda by + olmosh to'ldiruvchi shaklida keladi.

Ba'zi fe'llarda (give, send, show) ikki to'ldiruvchi bor. Ikkala variant ham to'g'ri:
They gave me a book. - I was given a book. / A book was given to me.

examples.en: Susan made a cake. - A cake was made by Susan.
examples.uz: Susan tort pishirdi. - Tort Susan tomonidan pishirildi.

examples.en: They clean the offices every night. - The offices are cleaned every night.
examples.uz: Ular ofislarni har kecha tozalashadi. - Ofislar har kecha tozalanadi.

examples.en: Someone is painting the wall. - The wall is being painted.
Dickens wrote Oliver Twist. - Oliver Twist was written by Dickens.
They have built a new school. - A new school has been built.
examples.uz: Ular yangi maktab qurishdi. - Yangi maktab qurildi.

mistakes.wrong: A cake made by Susan was.
mistakes.right: A cake was made by Susan.
mistakes.why: So'z tartibi: ega + to be + V3 + by.

mistakes.wrong: The car is repaired right now.
mistakes.right: The car is being repaired right now.
mistakes.why: Hozir davom etayotgan ish uchun is being + V3.

mistakes.wrong: The window was broken from them.
mistakes.right: The window was broken by them.

rules.tip: Ega va to'ldiruvchi o'rin almashadi, zamon esa joyida qoladi.

quiz.q: They built the bridge. - The bridge ___ by them.
quiz.why: Faol gap Past Simple edi, shuning uchun was built.

quiz.q: Someone is cleaning the car. - The car ___.
quiz.why: Davom etayotgan ish: is being + V3.

quiz.q: They haven't sent the letters yet. - The letters haven't ___ yet.
quiz.why: Present Perfect Passive: have been + V3.

rules.title: Majhul nisbat - qachon ishlatiladi
rules.summary: Ish muhim bo'lib, bajaruvchi noma'lum yoki ahamiyatsiz bo'lganda Passive ishlatiladi. Bajaruvchi (by ...) faqat muhim bo'lsa aytiladi.

sections.body:
• Bajaruvchi noma'lum: My bike was stolen. (kim o'g'irlagani noma'lum)
• Bajaruvchi hammaga ma'lum yoki ahamiyatsiz: English is spoken here.
• Ish yoki natija muhim: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889.

By + bajaruvchi faqat yangi yoki muhim ma'lumot bo'lsa aytiladi.
Oliver Twist was written by Charles Dickens. (muallif muhim)
My car was stolen. (by someone ketmaydi - ma'nosiz)

• Yangilik va gazeta sarlavhalari: A bank was robbed.
• Ilmiy va rasmiy matnlar, tavsiflar: Paper is made from wood.
• Binolar, mahsulotlar, tarix haqida: The tower was designed by Gustave Eiffel.
O'zbek tilida ham 'Ko'prik qurildi', 'Kitob yozilgan' deymiz. Ingliz tilida bunday gaplar ko'proq ishlatiladi, chunki ingliz gapda ega bo'lishi shart: 'qurishdi' o'rniga The bridge was built.

examples.en: My phone was stolen last night.
Spanish is spoken in many countries.
The Eiffel Tower was designed by Gustave Eiffel.
The museum is visited by thousands of people every year.
examples.uz: Muzeyga har yili minglab odamlar tashrif buyuradi.

examples.en: Rice is grown in warm countries.

mistakes.wrong: My bag was stolen by someone.
mistakes.why: 'By someone' ma'nosiz, bajaruvchi noma'lum bo'lsa tushirib qoldiriladi.

mistakes.right: The book was written by Dickens.

rules.tip: Passive = ish muhim. 'Kim qildi?' muhim bo'lsa Active ishlating.

quiz.q: The window ___ last night. (kim ekani noma'lum)

quiz.why: Asar muallif tomonidan yozilgan: was written by.

rules.title: Too va Enough
rules.summary: Too - 'juda, ortiqcha' (salbiy, qila olmaydi). Enough - 'yetarli'. Ikkalasi ham ko'pincha to + fe'l bilan keladi.

sections.body:
too + sifat / ravish (+ to + fe'l)
Bob is too short to reach the shelf. (juda past, yetolmaydi)

Too salbiy ma'no beradi: 'kerakdan ortiq'.
Too ko'pincha 'juda' degani, lekin 'very' dan farqi: very - shunchaki darajasi baland, too - natijasi yomon.

• sifat / ravish + enough (+ to + fe'l)
  He is tall enough to reach the shelf. (yetarli darajada baland)
• enough + ot
  We have enough chairs.

Enough sifatdan KEYIN keladi, otdan OLDIN keladi.

• not + sifat + enough = yetarli emas
  The soup isn't hot enough.
• too = ortiqcha, enough = yetarli
  too young = juda yosh (mumkin emas)
  old enough = yetarlicha katta (mumkin)

O'zbekcha: 'U juda yosh, ichkariga kira olmaydi' - too young. 'Yetarlicha katta, yura oladi' - old enough.
O'zbekcha 'yetarli' so'zi qayerda bo'lsa ham, inglizcha enough sifatdan keyin turadi.

examples.en: Bob is too short to reach the shelf.
examples.uz: Bob javonga yetish uchun juda past.

examples.en: The box is too heavy to carry.
She is old enough to drive.
examples.uz: U mashina haydash uchun yetarlicha katta.

examples.en: We don't have enough money.
It isn't warm enough to swim.

mistakes.wrong: She is enough old to drive.
mistakes.right: She is old enough to drive.

mistakes.wrong: The tea is too much hot.
mistakes.why: Too sifat bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri keladi, much kerak emas.

rules.tip: Too = ortiqcha (yomon). Enough = yetarli (yaxshi). Enough sifatdan keyin keladi.

quiz.q: She is tall ___ to reach it.

rules.title: Buyruq mayli (Imperative)
rules.summary: Buyruq, iltimos, ko'rsatma va ogohlantirish uchun ishlatiladi. Ega yozilmaydi, gap fe'l bilan boshlanadi.

sections.body:
• Tasdiq: fe'lning asosiy shakli
  Open the door!
• Inkor: Don't + fe'l
  Don't touch that!
• Kuchli taqiq: Never + fe'l
  Never play with matches.

Faqat 'you' (sen / siz) ga qaratiladi, ega yozilmaydi.

• Buyruq: Sit down!
• Ko'rsatma: Mix the eggs and the flour.
• Ogohlantirish: Be careful!
• Taklif: Come in and have a seat.
• Iltimos (please bilan yumshaydi): Please close the window.

• Let's + fe'l = 'keling ...aylik': Let's go!
• Be bilan: Be quiet! / Don't be late!
Be dan oldin do kerak emas: Be careful (Do be careful - kuchli ta'kid).

O'zbekcha: 'Eshikni oching!' - Open the door! Ega yo'q va fe'l o'zgarmagan. Inkori: 'Tegmang!' - Don't touch!
O'zbek tilida -ma qo'shimchasi bo'lsa, ingliz tilida don't qo'yiladi.

examples.en: Open your books.
Don't touch that!
Never leave children alone.
Be careful with the knife.
Let's go to the cinema.

mistakes.why: Don't dan keyin to'siz fe'l keladi.

rules.tip: Buyruqda ega yo'q: fe'l birinchi. Inkor = Don't / Never + fe'l.

quiz.why: Buyruq: fe'lning asosiy shakli, ega yo'q.

rules.title: O'zlik olmoshlari (Reflexive Pronouns)
rules.summary: O'zlik olmoshlari ish bajaruvchining o'ziga qaytganini ko'rsatadi: myself, yourself, himself va hokazo.

sections.body:
I - myself (o'zim)
you - yourself (o'zing)
he - himself (u o'zi, erkak)
she - herself (u o'zi, ayol)
it - itself (u o'zi, narsa/hayvon)
we - ourselves (o'zimiz)
you (ko'plik) - yourselves (o'zingiz)
they - themselves (ular o'zlari)

Birlikda -self, ko'plikda -selves.

1) Ega = to'ldiruvchi bo'lganda:
  I cut myself. (o'zimni kesib oldim)
2) Ta'kid uchun ('o'zi'):
  I made the cake myself.
3) By + o'zlik olmoshi = 'yolg'iz o'zi':
  He lives by himself.

O'zbekcha 'o'zim, o'zing, o'zi' ga to'g'ri keladi. Lekin ba'zi fe'llarda (wash, dress, shave, feel) ingliz tilida oddiy gapda o'zlik olmoshi kerak emas:
He washed. (u yuvindi) - himself shart emas.
Ma'noni ta'kidlash kerak bo'lsa ishlatiladi.

Ikki kishi bir-biriga ish qilsa each other ishlatiladi, yourselves emas:
They looked at each other. (bir-biriga qarashdi)
They looked at themselves. (har kim o'ziga qaradi)

examples.en: I hurt myself yesterday.
She taught herself to play the guitar.
We enjoyed ourselves at the party.
The children can dress themselves.
He cut himself with a knife.
examples.uz: U pichoq bilan o'zini kesib oldi.

mistakes.why: Ega va to'ldiruvchi bir xil odam bo'lsa o'zlik olmoshi kerak.

mistakes.wrong: Anna and Tom write to themselves every week.
mistakes.right: Anna and Tom write to each other every week.

rules.tip: Ish o'ziga qaytsa: -self (birlik), -selves (ko'plik). Himself, themselves - 'hisself', 'theirselves' emas.

quiz.q: She looked at ___ in the mirror.

rules.title: Might va Could - ehtimol
rules.summary: Might va could ehtimol, gumon, noaniq narsani bildiradi: 'bo'lishi mumkin'. Ikkalasidan keyin to'siz fe'l keladi.

sections.body:
• might / could + fe'l = '...ishi mumkin', '...ishi ehtimol'
  It might rain. (yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin)
  He could be at home. (uyda bo'lishi mumkin)
• Hamma shaxsda bir xil: I / he / they might go.
• Inkor: might not (mightn't kam ishlatiladi)
  It might not rain.

Might va could xavf haqida ogohlantiradi:
Never play with burning candles. You might start a fire.
Don't run on the ice. You could fall.
Bu 'qilsangiz, shunday bo'lishi mumkin' degan ma'no.

O'zbekcha 'balki', '-ishi mumkin', 'ehtimol' ga to'g'ri keladi: Yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin - It might rain.
Ingliz tilida fe'l o'zgarmaydi: she might goes emas, she might go.

• Might/could = aniq emas (ehtimol)
• Must = deyarli aniq
• Can't = aslo emas
So'roqda might kam ishlatiladi: Do you think it will rain? deyiladi.

examples.en: It might rain this afternoon.
examples.uz: Bugun tushdan keyin yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin.

examples.en: He could be in the library.
Don't touch the plug. You might get a shock.
She might not come to the party.
Be careful on the stairs. You could fall.
examples.uz: Zinada ehtiyot bo'ling. Yiqilib tushishingiz mumkin.

mistakes.why: Might dan keyin to'siz fe'l keladi, -s yo'q.
Might dan keyin to kerak emas.

rules.tip: Might / could + to'siz fe'l: ehtimol, aniq emas. Ogohlantirish: 'You might ...'.

quiz.q: He ___ be at home, but I'm not sure.

rules.title: Must va Have to - majburiyat
rules.summary: Must va have to 'kerak, majbur' ma'nosida. Must - so'zlovchining fikri, have to - tashqi qoida va zarurat. Mustn't - taqiq, don't have to - shart emas.

sections.body:
• must + fe'l - so'zlovchi o'zi kerak deb hisoblaydi:
  You must see a doctor.
• have to + fe'l - qoida yoki zarurat:
  I have to get up early. (maktab shunday talab qiladi)
• Have to hamma shaxsda: I / you / we / they have to, he / she / it has to.

• mustn't = qilish TAQIQLANGAN, mumkin emas
  You mustn't smoke here.
• don't have to = SHART EMAS (xohlasang qilasan)
  You don't have to wear a tie.
Ikkalasi bir xil emas! Mustn't - taqiq, don't have to - majburiy emas.

• Must so'roq: Must I go? (kamroq)
• Have to so'roq: Do I / you have to go? Does she have to go?
• Have to inkor: don't / doesn't have to
  She doesn't have to work on Sundays.

O'zbekcha 'kerak', 'shart' ikkala holatni qamrab oladi. 'Kerak emas' va 'mumkin emas' o'zbek tilida boshqa-boshqa, ingliz tilida ham:
'Kelmasangiz ham bo'ladi' = don't have to.
'Kelmang!' = mustn't.

examples.en: You must stay in bed.
I have to get up at six every day.
examples.uz: Men har kuni oltida turishim kerak.

examples.en: You mustn't touch that wire.
She doesn't have to wear a uniform.
Do you have to work on Saturdays?

mistakes.why: Must inkori mustn't, don't must emas.
He / she / it bilan has to ishlatiladi.

mistakes.right: Do you have to go? / Must you go?
mistakes.why: Do bilan have to ishlatiladi, must emas.

rules.tip: Mustn't = mumkin emas. Don't have to = shart emas. Bu ikkalasini aralashtirmang!

quiz.q: Tomorrow is Sunday. I ___ get up early.
She ___ work hard to pass the exam.

rules.title: Can va Be allowed to - ruxsat
rules.summary: Ruxsat va taqiq haqida: can / can't va be allowed to. Ikkalasi ham 'mumkin, ruxsat bor' ma'nosida.

sections.body:
• Can I + fe'l? - ruxsat so'rash
  Can I watch TV?
• Yes, you can. / No, you can't. - ruxsat yoki rad
• I'm afraid you can't take photos here.

Can so'zlovchi ruxsat berganida ishlatiladi.

Be allowed to + fe'l - qoida bo'yicha ruxsat bor:
• You are allowed to park here.
• You aren't allowed to smoke in the hospital.
• Are we allowed to use dictionaries?
To be shaxsga mos o'zgaradi: am / is / are allowed to.

A: Can I park here?
B: No, I'm afraid not. You aren't allowed to park here. You have to park somewhere else.

Rad etganda sababni yoki boshqa yo'lni ham aytish mumkin (have to ...).

O'zbekcha 'mumkin', 'ruxsat bor' ga to'g'ri keladi: Bu yerda to'xtash mumkin emas = You aren't allowed to park here.
Ingliz tilida can va be allowed to ruxsat berish uchun deyarli bir xil, lekin allowed rasmiy qoidada ko'proq.

examples.en: Can I use your phone?
You can't take photos in the museum.
Students are allowed to use dictionaries.
We aren't allowed to eat in class.
Are you allowed to stay out late?

mistakes.right: You aren't allowed to park here.
mistakes.why: Be allowed dan keyin to kerak.
Can dan keyin to kerak emas.

rules.tip: Can + to'siz fe'l. Be allowed + TO + fe'l.

rules.title: Had to va Could - o'tgan zamon
rules.summary: Had to - o'tmishda majbur edi. Could / couldn't - o'tmishda qila olardi / qila olmasdi. Didn't have to - shart emas edi.

sections.body:
Have to ning o'tgan zamoni - had to (hamma shaxsda bir xil).
• Tasdiq: I had to wear my best clothes.
• So'roq: Did you have to wear them? (Did + ega + have to)
• Inkor: I didn't have to wear them. (shart emas edi)

Can ning o'tgan zamoni - could (qila olardi), inkori couldn't (qila olmasdi).
When I was five, I could swim.
She couldn't come to the party.

Couldn't hamma shaxsda bir xil, fe'l to'siz keladi.

Bir marta bajarilgan ish uchun 'could' emas, 'was able to' yoki Past Simple:
I was able to find my keys. / I found my keys.
Har doim qila olish (qobiliyat) uchun could to'g'ri:
I could run fast when I was young.

O'zbekcha: 'kiyishga majbur edim' - had to wear. 'Kiyishim shart emas edi' - didn't have to wear. 'Suza olardim' - could swim.
O'tgan zamonda ham fe'l to'siz qoladi: didn't have to went emas, didn't have to go.

examples.en: We had to wear our best clothes.
examples.uz: Biz eng yaxshi kiyimlarimizni kiyishimiz kerak edi.

examples.en: Did they have to wear uniforms?
I didn't have to get up early yesterday.
examples.uz: Kecha erta turishim shart emas edi.

examples.en: She could speak French when she was ten.
examples.uz: U o'n yoshida frantsuzcha gapira olardi.

examples.en: I couldn't open the door.

mistakes.why: Could / couldn't dan keyin to kerak emas.

rules.tip: Did + have to, lekin had to - tasdiqda. Could / couldn't - qobiliyat, to'siz fe'l.

quiz.q: Yesterday was a holiday. We ___ go to school.
quiz.why: O'tgan zamonda shart emas: didn't have to.

quiz.q: When I was little, I ___ climb trees.
___ you have to wear a uniform?
quiz.why: O'tgan zamon so'roq: Did you have to ...?

rules.title: 2-tur shart gap (Second Conditional)
rules.summary: Hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy, real bo'lmagan vaziyat haqida: If + Past Simple, would + fe'l.

sections.body:
If + Past Simple, ... would / could / might + to'siz fe'l

If I had more free time, I would take up basketball.
(Agar bo'sh vaqtim ko'proq bo'lsa edi, basketbol bilan shug'ullanardim.)

Shart bo'lagi (if) boshida bo'lsa, vergul qo'yiladi. Oxirida bo'lsa vergul kerak emas:
I would take up basketball if I had more free time.

• Xayoliy, real bo'lmagan holat: If I were a bird, I would fly.
• Hozir yoki kelajak haqida, lekin real emas: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.
Bu 'o'tgan zamon' emas! Past Simple faqat shakl, ma'no hozirgi yoki kelajak.

• If bilan Past Simple: I had, you went, she knew.
• To be: hamma shaxsda were ishlatiladi: If I were rich, ... (was ham uchraydi, lekin were to'g'ri)
• Asosiy gapda: would (xohish, ehtimol), could (imkoniyat), might (balki)
• Would qisqa shakli: I'd, she'd

O'zbekcha: 'Agar ... bo'lsa edi, ...ardim' - If + Past Simple, would.
O'zbek tilida ikkala gapda ham '-sa edi / -ardi' bor, ingliz tilida esa if gapida Past Simple (would YO'Q), asosiy gapda would bor.

examples.en: If I were rich, I would buy a big house.
examples.uz: Agar boy bo'lsam edi, katta uy sotib olardim.

examples.en: If she had more time, she would learn French.
examples.uz: Agar uning vaqti ko'proq bo'lsa edi, frantsuz tilini o'rganardi.

examples.en: What would you do if you won a million dollars?
examples.uz: Agar million dollar yutsangiz nima qilardingiz?

examples.en: If we lived near the sea, we could swim every day.
examples.uz: Dengiz yaqinida yashasak edi, har kuni suza olardik.

examples.en: I wouldn't tell him if I were you.

mistakes.wrong: If I would have time, I would help you.
mistakes.right: If I had time, I would help you.
mistakes.why: If gapida would ishlatilmaydi, Past Simple kerak.

mistakes.wrong: If I am rich, I would buy a car.
mistakes.right: If I were rich, I would buy a car.

mistakes.wrong: If she knew, she will tell.
mistakes.right: If she knew, she would tell.

rules.tip: If + Past Simple, would + fe'l. Would faqat asosiy gapda, if gapida yo'q.

quiz.q: If I ___ a car, I would drive to work.
If he ___ harder, he would pass the exam.
She ___ happy if she lived in Paris.

rules.title: If I were you - maslahat berish
rules.summary: Maslahat berishning qulay yo'li: If I were you, I would ... ('sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, men ...ardim').

sections.body:
If I were you, I would + to'siz fe'l
If I were you, I would join a gym.
If I were you, I wouldn't eat so much chocolate.

Bu yerda 'I' bilan ham were ishlatiladi.

• Do'stga maslahat berishda: If I were you, I'd talk to the teacher.
• Muloyim fikr bildirishda: buyruqdan yumshoqroq.
Aslida 'sen' bo'lolmaysiz, shuning uchun bu xayoliy vaziyat.

• I would + fe'l, if I were you.
• Why don't you + fe'l?
• You should + fe'l.
If I were you ham ko'p ishlatiladi, ayniqsa suhbatda.
O'zbekcha: 'Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, ...' - If I were you, ... Faqat were shakliga e'tibor bering: If I was you ham gapirib yuboriladi, lekin to'g'risi were.

examples.en: If I were you, I would see a doctor.
If I were you, I wouldn't buy that car.
examples.uz: Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, u mashinani sotib olmasdim.

examples.en: If I were you, I'd take an umbrella.
What would you do if you were me?
If I were you, I'd go for a walk.

mistakes.wrong: If I am you, I will go.
mistakes.right: If I were you, I would go.

mistakes.wrong: If I would be you, I'd go.
mistakes.right: If I were you, I'd go.

mistakes.wrong: If I were you, I would to go.
mistakes.right: If I were you, I would go.

rules.tip: Maslahat uchun: If I were you, I would ...

quiz.q: If I ___ you, I would study harder.
If I were you, I ___ eat that.
Give advice: 'If I ___ you, I would call her.'

rules.title: Joylashuvni tasvirlash
rules.summary: Joy va yo'nalishni tasvirlash: is situated / is located + in / on + yo'nalish + of ...

sections.body:
• Place + is situated / is located + in the north / south / east / west of + joy
  The city is located in the north of the country.
• On the coast: on the east coast of ...
• Situated va located bir xil ma'noda: 'joylashgan'.

north (N) - shimol
south (S) - janub
east (E) - sharq
west (W) - g'arb
north-west - shimoli-g'arb
south-east - janubi-sharq

In the north of - biror joyning ichidagi qismi
To the north of - biror joydan tashqarida, shimol tomonda

• on the coast / on a river / on an island
• near / close to
• between ... and ...
• on the border of
  Spain is in the south-west of Europe.
O'zbekcha: '...ning shimolida joylashgan' - is located in the north of ... Of dan keyin joy nomi keladi. Ingliz tilida 'in the north' (ichida) bilan 'to the north' (tashqarida) farqlanadi.

examples.en: Paris is located in the north of France.
Spain is situated in the south-west of Europe.
The town is on the east coast of England.
Canada is to the north of the USA.
The hotel is located near the airport.

mistakes.wrong: The city is in north of the country.
mistakes.right: The city is in the north of the country.
mistakes.why: 'The' va 'of' ni unutmang: in the north of.

mistakes.wrong: Paris is situated in France north.
mistakes.right: Paris is situated in the north of France.
mistakes.why: Yo'nalish oldin, joy nomi 'of' dan keyin.

mistakes.wrong: It is locating in the east.
mistakes.right: It is located in the east.

rules.tip: In the north OF ... (ichida), to the north OF ... (tashqarida). Located va situated = joylashgan.

quiz.q: Tashkent is ___ the east of Uzbekistan.
quiz.why: Mamlakat ichida: in the east of.

quiz.q: Berlin ___ in the north-east of Germany.

rules.title: Nisbiy olmoshlar - who, which, where
rules.summary: Who, which, where ikki gapni birlashtiradi va ot haqida qo'shimcha ma'lumot beradi: who - odam, which - narsa, where - joy.

sections.body:
• who - odamlar: a woman who works here
• which - narsa va hayvonlar: a book which is interesting
• where - joy: a town where I was born

O'zbekcha 'kim, qaysi, qayer' ga yaqin.

I met a woman. She's from France.
→ I met a woman who is from France.

Ikkinchi gapdagi 'she' o'rniga 'who' qo'yiladi, ikkala gap bitta bo'ladi. 'Who' ega vazifasida bo'lsa, boshqa olmosh (she) qo'shilmaydi.

Where joyga bog'liq gapda ishlatiladi:
That's the restaurant where we had lunch.
Where dan keyin ega + fe'l keladi: where we had, where he lives.

• Who - faqat odamlar
• Which - narsalar
• That - ikkalasi uchun (oddiy gapda)
Misol: the girl who/that lives here; the car which/that is red.

examples.en: I met a woman who is from France.
A sailor is someone who works at sea.
This is the book which I told you about.
Space Camp is a place where children learn about space.
examples.uz: Space Camp - bolalar koinot haqida o'rganadigan joy.

examples.en: The film which we saw was great.

mistakes.wrong: A doctor is a person which helps sick people.
mistakes.right: A doctor is a person who helps sick people.

mistakes.wrong: The girl who she lives here is my friend.
mistakes.right: The girl who lives here is my friend.
mistakes.why: Ega vazifasida who bo'lsa, she qo'shilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: The shop which I bought it is closed.
mistakes.right: The shop where I bought it is closed.
mistakes.why: Joy uchun where. Which ishlatilsa ham 'it' qo'shilmaydi.

rules.tip: Odam - who, narsa - which, joy - where. Olmosh o'rniga qo'yiladi, takrorlanmaydi.

quiz.q: The man ___ lives next door is a teacher.
This is the town ___ I was born.
I like films ___ make me laugh.

rules.title: Some, Any, No va ularning birikmalari
rules.summary: Some - tasdiq, any - so'roq va inkor, no - inkor ma'noli tasdiq gapda. Someone, something, somewhere kabi birikmalar ham shu qoidaga amal qiladi.

sections.body:
• some - tasdiq: She has some bread.
• any - so'roq va inkor: Have you got any milk? I haven't got any milk.
• no = not any (inkor ma'no, fe'l tasdiq shaklda): I have no milk. = I don't have any milk.

Some:  someone / somebody (kimdir), something (nimadir), somewhere (qayerdadir)
Any:   anyone / anybody, anything, anywhere
No:    no one / nobody, nothing, nowhere

Qoida o'zgarmaydi: tasdiqda some-, so'roq/inkorda any-.

So'roqda taklif yoki iltimos bo'lsa some ishlatiladi:
Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?
Bu yerda javob 'ha' kutiladi.

Inglizda bitta gapda ikkita inkor ishlatilmaydi:
I don't have nothing. - XATO
I don't have anything. / I have nothing. - TO'G'RI

examples.en: There is someone at the door.
I haven't got anything to wear.
Is there anywhere to sit?
Would you like something to drink?
There is nobody in the room.

rules.tip: Tasdiq - some-, so'roq / inkor - any-, 'no' inkor ma'noni o'zi ko'taradi (fe'l tasdiq).

quiz.q: I looked ___ but I couldn't find my keys.

rules.title: Infinitiv (to + fe'l)
rules.summary: Infinitiv - fe'lning asosiy shakli. Ikki xil: to-infinitiv (to go) va to'siz (go). Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin to + fe'l keladi.

sections.body:
To + fe'l keladigan holatlar:
• Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin: decide, want, agree, hope, plan, need, promise, learn
  I want to learn English.
• Maqsad (nima uchun?): I went to the shop to buy bread.
• Sifatlardan keyin: It's easy to learn.

To kerak emas bo'lgan holatlar:
• Modal fe'llardan keyin: can, must, should, might + fe'l
• Let + kishi + fe'l: He let us go.
• Make + kishi + fe'l: She made me laugh.

Inkor shakl: not + to + fe'l
She decided not to go.
He told me not to wait.

O'zbekcha -moq / -ish: 'o'rganmoq, bormoq'. Ingliz tilida 'to learn, to go'.
'Bormoqchiman' - I want to go: fe'ldan keyin to + fe'l ishlatiladi.

examples.en: She decided to study medicine.
I want to learn English.
They agreed to help us.
examples.uz: Ular bizga yordam berishga rozi bo'lishdi.

examples.en: He went to the bank to get some money.
examples.uz: U pul olish uchun bankka bordi.

examples.en: Our teacher won't let us use phones.

mistakes.why: Let dan keyin to'siz fe'l keladi.

rules.tip: Want, decide, agree, hope + TO + fe'l. Can, must, let + to'siz fe'l.

rules.title: -ing shakli (gerundiy)
rules.summary: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ing shaklida keladi: love, like, hate, enjoy, don't mind, finish.

sections.body:
-ing keladigan fe'llar:
• love, like, hate, enjoy: Tom likes playing basketball.
• don't mind, can't stand, finish, keep: She finished writing.
• go + -ing (sport, hobbi): go fishing, go swimming

• Predloglardan keyin: I'm good at cooking. / Thank you for helping.
• Ega vazifasida: Swimming is good for you.
Predlogdan keyin doim -ing: before leaving, after eating.

Like, love, hate dan keyin to + fe'l ham, -ing ham mumkin, ma'no deyarli bir xil:
I like to swim. = I like swimming.
'Would like' dan keyin faqat to + fe'l: I would like to swim.

• Oddiy: play - playing
• -e tushadi: make - making
• Qisqa unli + undosh qo'shiladi: swim - swimming, run - running

examples.en: Tom likes playing basketball.
I enjoy reading at night.
She doesn't mind waiting.
They went fishing last weekend.
examples.uz: Ular o'tgan dam olish kunlari baliq tutgani borishdi.

examples.en: He is good at drawing.

mistakes.wrong: I'm looking forward to see you.
mistakes.right: I'm looking forward to seeing you.
mistakes.why: Look forward to dagi 'to' predlog, shuning uchun -ing.

rules.tip: Enjoy, finish, don't mind, predloglar + -ing.

rules.title: Stop, Remember, Forget - ma'no farqi
rules.summary: Stop, remember, forget dan keyin to + fe'l yoki -ing kelishi mumkin, ma'no esa o'zgaradi.

sections.body:
• stop + to + fe'l = boshqa ish uchun to'xtash
  I stopped to have a coffee. (qahva ichish uchun to'xtadim)
• stop + -ing = qilayotgan ishni to'xtatish
  I stopped smoking. (chekishni tashladim)

• remember + to + fe'l = qilishni esda saqlash (hali qilinmagan)
  Remember to lock the door. (eshikni qulflashni unutma)
• remember + -ing = qilingan ishni eslash
  I remember meeting him. (u bilan uchrashganimni eslayman)

• forget + to + fe'l = qilishni unutish (qilmadi)
  I forgot to call you.
• forget + -ing = qilganini unutish
  I'll never forget seeing the sea.

To + fe'l - kelajak yoki bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan ish.
-ing - o'tgan, bajarilgan yoki davom etgan ish.

examples.en: I stopped to buy a newspaper.
She stopped talking when he came in.
Remember to call your mother.
I remember visiting that castle.
He forgot to turn off the lights.

mistakes.why: To bilan 'chekish uchun to'xtadim' degan ma'no chiqadi.
Qilinishi kerak bo'lgan ish: to + fe'l.

rules.tip: TO = hali qilinmagan ish. -ING = qilib bo'lingan ish.

quiz.why: Qilish kerak bo'lgan ish: to post.

rules.title: Ko'chirma darak gap (Reported Statements)
rules.summary: Birovning aytgan gapini o'z so'zimiz bilan yetkazish: olmoshlar va zamon o'zgaradi (zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi).

sections.body:
1) Olmoshlar (ma'noga qarab):
  Ed said, "I live in Belfast." → Ed said (that) he lived in Belfast.
2) Zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi.
3) Vaqt va joy so'zlari o'zgaradi.

Present Simple → Past Simple: "I work." → he said he worked.
Present Continuous → Past Continuous: "I'm working." → he said he was working.
Past Simple → Past Perfect: "I worked." → he said he had worked.
Present Perfect → Past Perfect: "I have worked." → he said he had worked.
Will → would; can → could.

now → then
today → that day
yesterday → the day before
tomorrow → the next day
here → there
this → that

'That' ixtiyoriy: He said (that) he was tired.

O'zbek tilida ko'chirma gapda zamon odatda o'zgarmaydi: 'U menga: 'Charchadim', dedi' - 'U charchaganini aytdi'.
Ingliz tilida said / told dan keyin zamon orqaga suriladi (is → was).

examples.en: She said, "I am tired." → She said she was tired.
"We live in London." → They said they lived in London.
"I bought a car." → He said he had bought a car.
"I will help you." → She said she would help me.
"I can swim." → He said he could swim.

mistakes.wrong: He said that he is tired.
mistakes.right: He said that he was tired.
mistakes.why: Said (o'tgan zamon) dan keyin zamon orqaga suriladi.

mistakes.wrong: She said me that she was ill.
mistakes.right: She told me that she was ill.

mistakes.why: Ko'chirma gapda vergul va qo'shtirnoq kerak emas.

rules.tip: Said / told dan keyin: zamon bir pog'ona orqaga, olmosh ma'noga mos.

quiz.q: "I like pizza," Tom said. → Tom said he ___ pizza.
"I have finished," she said. → She said she ___ finished.
"I'll call you," he said. → He said he ___ call me.

rules.title: Say va Tell farqi
rules.summary: Say va tell ikkalasi 'aytmoq', lekin tell dan keyin kimga aytilgani ALBATTA kerak, say dan keyin shart emas.

sections.body:
Tell + KIMGA + (that) ...
He told me that he was busy.
She told the children a story.
Tell dan keyin odam (kimga) shart.

Say + (that) ... (kimga aytilgani shart emas)
He said (that) he was busy.
Kimga bo'lsa: say TO + kishi:
He said to me that he was busy. (kam ishlatiladi)

• tell the truth, tell a lie, tell a story, tell a joke, tell the time
• say hello, say goodbye, say thank you, say a prayer

• told me ✓ (odam bor) - said me ✗
• said that ... ✓ (odamsiz) - told that ... ✗
Odam bor - tell. Odam yo'q - say.

examples.en: Tom told me he was tired.
Tom said he was tired.
The guide told the visitors to wait.
She said to the teacher that she was ill.
Ben told a funny story.

mistakes.wrong: He said me that he was busy.
mistakes.right: He told me that he was busy.

mistakes.wrong: She told that she was happy.
mistakes.right: She said that she was happy.

mistakes.wrong: She told to me that she was ill.
mistakes.right: She told me that she was ill.
