mistakes.why: Tell dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi, odam bevosita keladi.

rules.tip: Tell + kishi. Say + (kishisiz). Said me - hech qachon!

quiz.q: She ___ me that she was late.

quiz.why: Said TO me yoki told me.

rules.title: Ko'chirma savollar (Reported Questions)
rules.summary: Ko'chirma savolda gap tartibi oddiy gap kabi bo'ladi (ega + fe'l), do/does/did ishlatilmaydi, savol belgisi qo'yilmaydi.

sections.body:
1) So'z tartibi tasdiq gap kabi: ega + fe'l, do/does/did yo'q
  "Where do you live?" → She asked where I lived.
2) Savol belgisi (?) qo'yilmaydi.
3) Zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi.

ask + wh- so'z + ega + fe'l
"What time is it?" → He asked what time it was.
"Where are you going?" → She asked where I was going.
Asked / wanted to know ishlatiladi.

Ha/yo'q savolda if yoki whether ishlatiladi:
"Do you like tea?" → She asked if I liked tea.
"Are you ready?" → He asked whether I was ready.

O'zbekcha: 'U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi.' Bu yerda ham so'roq so'zdan keyin oddiy gap tartibi: 'qayerda yashashimni'.
Ingliz tilida shu tartibni saqlash kerak: where I lived (where did I live emas).

examples.en: "Where do you live?" → She asked where I lived.
"What is your name?" → He asked what my name was.
"Do you like coffee?" → She asked if I liked coffee.
"Is it raining?" → He asked whether it was raining.
"Where did you go?" → She wanted to know where I had gone.

mistakes.wrong: She asked where did I live.
mistakes.why: Ko'chirma savolda so'z tartibi tasdiq gap kabi.

mistakes.wrong: He asked if I liked tea?
mistakes.right: He asked if I liked tea.

mistakes.wrong: She asked do I like coffee.
mistakes.right: She asked if I liked coffee.

rules.tip: Savol so'zi + ega + fe'l. Do / does / did va (?) yo'q.

quiz.q: "Do you speak French?" → She asked ___ I spoke French.
"What time is it?" → He asked what time ___.

rules.title: Umumiy haqiqatlarni ko'chirish
rules.summary: Umumiy haqiqat va hozir ham to'g'ri bo'lgan gaplarni ko'chirganda zamon ko'pincha o'zgarmaydi.

sections.body:
Hamma vaqt to'g'ri bo'lgan fakt haqida:
"Parrots live in Mexico." → He said that parrots live in Mexico.
Zamon o'zgarmaydi, chunki fakt hozir ham to'g'ri.

Ko'pincha ikkala shakl ham to'g'ri:
She said the Earth goes round the Sun.
She said the Earth went round the Sun.
Fakt hali ham to'g'ri bo'lsa, o'zgartirmaslik tabiiyroq.

• Gap endi to'g'ri bo'lmasa: "I live in Paris." - u endi ko'chib ketgan bo'lsa: She said she lived in Paris.
• Rasmiy yoki yozma uslubda zamon o'zgartiriladi.
O'zbek tilida zamon o'zgarmaydi: 'U Yer Quyosh atrofida aylanishini aytdi'. Shuning uchun faktlarda ingliz tili ham o'zbekchaga yaqin bo'ladi.

examples.en: The teacher said that water boils at 100 degrees.
He told us that the sun rises in the east.
examples.uz: U bizga quyosh sharqdan chiqishini aytdi.

examples.en: She said that Paris is the capital of France.
examples.uz: U Parij Fransiya poytaxti ekanini aytdi.

examples.en: They said that elephants are very big.
examples.uz: Ular fillar juda katta ekanini aytishdi.

examples.en: He said that parrots live in Mexico.

mistakes.wrong: He said that parrots lives in Mexico.
mistakes.right: He said that parrots live in Mexico.
mistakes.why: Parrots - ko'plik, shuning uchun live (lives emas).

mistakes.wrong: He said water boil at 100 degrees.
mistakes.right: He said water boils at 100 degrees.
mistakes.why: Water - birlik, shuning uchun boils (-s kerak).

mistakes.wrong: She said that Paris are the capital of France.
mistakes.right: She said that Paris is the capital of France.

mistakes.wrong: He said that elephants are big?
mistakes.right: He said that elephants are big.

rules.tip: Doim to'g'ri bo'lgan fakt - zamon o'zgarmaydi.

quiz.q: "The Earth is round." → He said that the Earth ___ round.
"Cats like fish." → She said that cats ___ fish.

rules.title: Ko'chirma buyruq va ko'rsatmalar
rules.summary: Buyruq, iltimos va ko'rsatmani ko'chirganda ask / tell / order + kimga + (not) + to + fe'l qolipi ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
ask / tell / order + KIMGA + (not) + TO + fe'l
"Be polite with the customers," said the manager.
→ The manager told us to be polite with the customers.

Inkor buyruq: not + to + fe'l
"Don't touch that!" → She told him not to touch that.

• ask - iltimos (yumshoq): She asked me to close the window.
• tell - oddiy buyruq: He told us to sit down.
• order - qat'iy buyruq: The officer ordered them to stop.
Kimga (me, us, him, them) majburiy.
Buyruq ko'chirmasida zamon o'zgarishi kerak emas: shunchaki to + fe'l. Faqat olmosh va vaqt so'zlari o'zgaradi (here → there, now → then).
O'zbekcha: 'U menga eshikni yopishimni so'radi.' Ingliz tilida: She asked me to close the door. Bu yerda 'yopishimni' o'rniga 'to + fe'l' keladi, ega qo'shimcha yo'q.

examples.en: "Open the window," she said. → She told me to open the window.
"Please help me," he said. → He asked me to help him.
"Don't be late!" → The teacher told us not to be late.
"Stop!" → The officer ordered them to stop.
"Don't touch that," Mum said. → Mum told me not to touch that.

mistakes.wrong: She told me close the window.
mistakes.right: She told me to close the window.

mistakes.wrong: He told to me to wait.
mistakes.why: Tell dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri odam.

mistakes.right: She told him not to go.

rules.tip: Ask / tell / order + kishi + (not) to + fe'l.

quiz.q: "Sit down," the teacher said. → The teacher told us ___.
"Please open the door." → He ___ me to open the door.

rules.title: Undov gaplar (Exclamations)
rules.summary: Undov gaplar his-tuyg'uni bildiradi. Ikki asosiy qolip: What ... ! (ot bilan) va How ... ! (sifat/ravish bilan).

sections.body:
What + a/an + (sifat) + birlik sanaladigan ot!
What a beautiful day!
What an experience!

Ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan otlarda a/an tushadi:
What beautiful flowers! What terrible weather!

How + sifat / ravish!
How wonderful! How exciting! How quickly he runs!
How dan keyin ot kelmaydi (faqat sifat yoki ravish).

• Ot bor - What: What a fantastic house!
• Faqat sifat - How: How fantastic!
• Vergul va undov belgisi: gap oxirida ! qo'yiladi.
O'zbekcha: 'Qanday go'zal kun!', 'Naqadar ajoyib!' - ikkalasi ham undov. Inglizcha what va how ni ot borligiga qarab tanlang.

examples.en: What a beautiful day!
What an interesting book!
What terrible weather!
How wonderful!
How fast he runs!

mistakes.why: Birlik sanaladigan otdan oldin a/an kerak.

rules.tip: Ot bo'lsa WHAT (+a/an). Faqat sifat bo'lsa HOW.

quiz.why: Birlik sanaladigan ot (surprise): What a lovely surprise!

rules.title: Ajratilgan savollar (Question Tags)
rules.summary: Question tag - gap oxiridagi qisqa savol ('shundaymi?', 'to'g'rimi?'). Tasdiq gapdan keyin inkor tag, inkor gapdan keyin tasdiq tag keladi.

sections.body:
Tasdiq gap → inkor tag:
Dogs swim, don't they?
Your father is a farmer, isn't he?

Inkor gap → tasdiq tag:
She doesn't like tea, does she?
They aren't here, are they?
Tag ega olmoshi (he, she, it, they) + yordamchi fe'l.

• Gapdagi yordamchi fe'l (is, are, was, have, will, can) takrorlanadi: You can swim, can't you?
• Present Simple: do / does: He likes tea, doesn't he?
• Past Simple: did: They left, didn't they?

• I am → aren't I? I am quick, aren't I? (amn't yo'q)
• Buyruq (Don't ...) → will you? Don't talk, will you?
• Let's → shall we? Let's go, shall we?
• Nothing / nobody → tasdiq tag: Nothing happened, did it?

• Ohang pasaysa - tasdiqlash so'rash: It's cold, isn't it? (aslida bilaman)
• Ohang ko'tarilsa - haqiqiy savol: You're coming, aren't you? (bilmayman)

examples.en: It's a nice day, isn't it?
You don't like coffee, do you?
She can drive, can't she?
They went home, didn't they?
I am late, aren't I?

mistakes.why: I am bilan aren't I ishlatiladi.
Present Simple tasdiq - don't you? (are you emas)

rules.tip: Tasdiq - inkor tag. Inkor - tasdiq tag. I am - aren't I?

quiz.why: Tasdiq gap, Present Simple: don't they?
Inkor gap - tasdiq tag: is she?
